epic.title: pm-beads v1: Linear-style web UI for beads
epic.description: A local, lightweight Linear-style web UI on top of the beads (bd) issue tracker. Greenfield TanStack Start app (decided over forking beads-web, which is 28K LOC of Next.js + Rust/Axum whose UI we'd mostly replace anyway). Stack: TanStack Start, TanStack Table, shadcn/ui, Tailwind, zod, Biome. Data access: server functions shelling out to bd --json. V1 scope: projects (epics) view with expandable child issues, issues view with Linear-style grouping/sorting/filtering, side-panel detail with inline edits. Deferred: workspace picker (single project via config), board view, charts.
